model: DM.1.1-MB modulating damper actuators (BACnet MS/TP / Modbus RTU)
applies_to: Frakta DMS1.1-MB, DM1.1-MB, DML1.1-MB and DMG1.1-MB modulating damper actuators (8-32 Nm) with BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU.
summary: The DM.1.1-MB actuators are 24 V modulating air damper actuators from 8 to 32 Nm. A DIP switch selects BACnet MS/TP or Modbus RTU. Over BACnet the BMS overrides the analog control input (AI 0) to position the damper and reads position, run, blocked and dew point states; a watchdog decides what happens if the BMS stops writing.
notes: AV 0 is printed 'Positison' in the object list.
AI 0 and AO 0 exist only on modulating (analog controlled) actuators.
AI 0 takes 0-10; without a new write within 60 s it returns to the physical analog input value.

integration.summary: Switch DIP 4 to BACnet MS/TP, set the address on the address switches, then write the position command to AI 0 (0-10) at least every 60 s. Read AV 0 position and BV 3 for a blocked actuator. Set MV 1 and MV 2 to decide how the watchdog behaves.
integration.enable: Mode switch position 4 selects BACnet MS/TP (the other setting is Modbus RTU).
integration.heartbeat: AI 0 falls back to the physical analog input if not rewritten within 60 s. The watchdog (AV 1 WD_timeout, MV 1 WD_mode, MV 2 WD_action) can close, open, follow the analog input or do nothing when it trips; the manual also states the actuator closes if the control value doesn't change within 60 s.
setup: Default bus speed 9600 bps; change it with MV 0.
Restore defaults: power off, set address 15 (DEC), power on.
Mode switch also sets 0-10/2-10 V range, rotation direction and voltage/current input.
gotchas: A blocked actuator retries after 60 s or when driven the other way.
